title: Jalen Brunson: Villanova to Madison Square
description: Two titles, a dad who played the point, and a late-draft steal who became New York's captain—five steps into Brunson.
imageHint: The steady point guard in blue and orange, orchestrating plays with calm precision in pressure moments

questions.question: Jalen Brunson won how many NCAA titles as Villanova's point guard?
questions.explanation: Titles in 2016 and 2018. As a junior he was consensus National Player of the Year and Final Four all-tournament.

questions.question: After those two titles, Dallas selected Brunson where in the 2018 NBA Draft?
questions.explanation: A second-rounder at pick 33. Four years later he walked into free agency as one of the league's most wanted guards.

questions.question: Leaving Dallas as a free agent in 2022, Brunson signed with which Eastern Conference franchise?
questions.explanation: A four-year deal that remade the Knicks overnight. Villanova teammates Josh Hart and Donte DiVincenzo later joined him in New York.

questions.question: Brunson's father, who also ran the point in the NBA—including a stop in New York—is named what?
questions.explanation: Rick played nine seasons for eight teams and later coached. Jalen grew up in gyms from Cherry Hill to Lincolnshire, Illinois.

questions.question: With Rick's old New York club now his team, what number jersey did Villanova retire for Jalen in 2023?
questions.explanation: Retired Feb. 8, 2023—the day before the Knicks traded for Josh Hart. Brunson was later named the 36th captain in Knicks history.

easterEgg.title: 56 in a state final
easterEgg.text: At Stevenson High in Illinois, Brunson dropped 56 points in an IHSA finals game—a state-final scoring record—against a team featuring future No. 1 pick Jahlil Okafor.
